top_signals.title: Warriors planning for star guard Stephen Curry to finish career with team
top_signals.summary: Both sides have previously expressed interest in Curry finishing his career in San Francisco, and little has happened to indicate either party has had a change of ​heart.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
